title: tool_doswin: remove the max length check
body: A too long name is likely to cause a problem later anyway and get reported there. We don't enforce file name lengths for any other systems.

files.patch:
@@ -179,15 +179,6 @@ static CURLcode test_tool1604(const char *arg)
     { "COM56", 0,
       "COM56", SANITIZE_ERR_OK
     },
-    { "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
-      "BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB"
-      "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC"
-      "DDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDD"
-      "EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE"
-      "FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF",
-        0,
-      NULL, SANITIZE_ERR_INVALID_PATH
-    },
     { NULL, 0,
       NULL, SANITIZE_ERR_BAD_ARGUMENT
     },
